name: Tool — Functions (custom)
summary: FunctionTool with a client-side Python callable, attached to a BYOM-routed agent.
description: `FunctionTool` lets a Prompt Agent declare JSON-schema function calls that the SDK maps to local callables while the orchestrator model is `{connection}/{deployment}`. This enables deterministic app actions or data lookups without routing a separate tool model.
notes:
Verified end-to-end with a JSON-schema `FunctionTool` on a BYOM-routed Prompt Agent. See `test.py`.

Function calling is on the official BYOM-supported tools list.
